findings.title: Toast import in useErrorHandler
findings.description: useErrorHandler imports toast from '@/lib/toast', creating coupling between error handling and notification system. If toast module changes or is unavailable, error handling breaks. Consider passing toast function as parameter or using dependency injection.

findings.title: Production console logging
findings.description: error-handler.ts logs console.error('[Error]', error.type, error.message) in production (line 111). This exposes error types and messages to browser console which could leak implementation details. Remove production console logging or log only generic identifiers.

findings.title: No test coverage
findings.description: None of the error boundary components, ErrorHandler categorization logic, or useErrorHandler hook have tests. Edge cases (malformed Axios errors, missing response properties, TypeError network detection) are untested. Add unit tests for error categorization and integration tests for boundary hierarchy.

findings.title: Hard-coded /dashboard navigation
findings.description: GlobalErrorBoundary, error.tsx, and not-found.tsx navigate to '/dashboard' on error recovery. This assumes all users have access to dashboard. If a student role lacks dashboard access, navigation fails silently. Verify dashboard route is accessible to all roles or make target route role-aware.

findings.title: Missing ARIA live regions
findings.description: ErrorFallback variants announce errors through visual UI but don't use aria-live regions to notify screen reader users of dynamic error states. When an error boundary triggers after initial page load, screen reader users may miss the error message unless they manually explore the page. Add role='alert' or aria-live='assertive' to error containers.
